name: Truthifi
description: Read your Truthifi household data: accounts, activity, holdings, fees, performance, cash flow, the advisors on your accounts, financial diagnostics and your Truthifi Score. It cannot move money or place trades; three tools create, delete or rescan data inside Truthifi.

auth.instructions: Sign in to Truthifi in your browser (OAuth). The server supports Dynamic Client Registration, so no client ID or API key is needed. Free plan available; some tools need a paid plan.
